title: Decision
description: An item of kind decision: a question for a decider (design part 3.2). proposed while being framed, planned once asked, done when answered, dropped if mooted; never in-progress. Derived fields (blocks, cost_of_delay_rate) are never stored.

owner.description: Who is accountable for this record. Defaults to the owner: the person who holds the project's decision rights.

opened_from.description: Signal, opportunity or decision IDs this was opened from.

needs.description: IDs that must be Done before this is ready.

context.description: Two to five sentences: what is known, what prompted it.

precedent_offer.description: The generalization offered with the question (design part 4.3 and Q3). The decider confirms it with the answer, and then it becomes a precedent without a second round trip.

summary.description: What the offer line names: "Future cases like this (<summary>): treat the same way?"

rule.description: "When <conditions>, do <action>", in plain language. The action is what the precedent applies.

decider.description: "owner", an area owner's contributor ID, or a named role.

default_if_unanswered.description: Two-way doors only: the option taken, and logged, if the deadline passes. The orchestrator sets one on every question that is easy to undo; `hitld rights sweep` applies it once the deadline has passed, and the owner can reverse it.

answered_via.description: The channel the answer came through, "precedent" when a precedent resolved it, or "default" when no one answered and the question took its default.

answered_by.description: Who answered: "owner", or a decider's contributor ID once signed answers exist (Q21). Absent when a precedent resolved it or a default was applied.

precedent.description: The precedent created from this decision, if any.

resolved_by_precedent.description: The precedent that resolved it, when no person answered.
